scientific_limitations: Only the coordinate-preserving block permutation U_sigma is considered, not arbitrary internal wreath-unit coordinates.
The exact centralizer rank polynomial is deduced from a combinatorial proof; finite checks cover only specified small cases.
Earlier general idempotent descriptions and cycle-divisibility criteria are acknowledged; an equivalent older full rank enumerator could remain unlocated.
title: Cycle-divisibility rank spectra of equivariant retractions of uniform partitions
